Subsection.title: Name
Subsection.Paragraph: list-instruments - List instruments in the local inventory.

Subsection.title: Description
Subsection.Paragraph: The list-instruments command lists instruments installed in the local inventory.

FormalItem.title: Example
FormalItem.Verbatim: $ aradine-cli inventory list-instruments [ { "Type" : "Instrument", "Group" : "com.io7m.aradine", "Name" : "com.io7m.aradine.instrument.sampler_m0", "Version" : "0.0.2", "Identifier" : "com.io7m.aradine:com.io7m.aradine.instrument.sampler_m0:0.0.2", "Title" : "Sampler M0", "Description" : "The simplest monophonic sampler." } ]
